manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top of a vertical throw, velocity passes through zero while acceleration remains -g and force stays mg downward.
manifest.description: Left, a ball moves vertically on a ruler with velocity and acceleration arrows alongside dynamic readouts. Right, a plot shows velocity decreasing linearly over time, zeroing at the motion's top.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare the readings at each pause near the top. Change mass while paused to compare force and acceleration.
